notes.title: Patch Notes Version 1.4
notes.content:
[b]Thank you for all your support and feedback on the game! This update brings the highly requested feature for remapping inputs, new unique weapons and bug fixes.[/b]

[u]Here is the full breakdown:[/u]

[b]What’s New?[/b]
[list]
[*] Added Input Mappings menu.
[*] Added the “Alchemist Staff”.
[*] Added the “Flame Sword”.
[*] Added the “Halberd”.
[*] Added the “Black Knight Blade”.
[*] Added the “Pitchfork”.
[*] Added the “Great Hammer”.
[/list]
[b]Updates & Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Reduced max durability of “The Penetrator” magic wand.
[*] Updated Buff VFX & SFX.
[*] Updated saving sound to be played less frequently.
[*] Updated weapon hit tracing to be more accurate.
[*] Fixed buffs/debuffs received from items weren’t always removed when unequipping the item.
[*] Fixed enemy rage sometimes activated after death.
[*] Fixed save game info displaying wrong floor information.
[*] And made various balance changes.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes Version 1.3
notes.content:
[b]This is the first official update for the game, thank you all for your support and feedback! In this update, we focused on reworking how blocking and shields work and brought in some new shields. We also made changes to existing weapons to make them more unique and fixed various issues.[/b]

[u]Here is the full breakdown:[/u]

[b]What’s New?[/b]

[list]
[*] Blocking now reduces the incoming damage by absolute values instead of percentages. Also the player is now able to rotate and move slowly while blocking and only successfully blocks or parries when facing the attacker. Shields are now classified into different categories that affect how fast the character is able to handle them.

[*] Additionally we added parrying for some shields (see item description whether a shield has parrying) which is activated with a short right click to cancel an incoming attack when timed correctly. Also has an additional effect on the attacker depending on the shield.
[*] Added the “Riposte Shield”.
[*] Added the “Poisonthorn Shield”.
[*] Added the “Goblin Shield”.
[*] Added the “Honey Shield”.
[*] Added the “Tombstone Shield”.
[*] Added a setting to choose between “Hold to Sprint” and “Toggle Sprint” to the settings menu.
[/list]

[b]Combat & Balancing Updates[/b]

[list]
[*] Updated primary attack for “Verdant Reaver”, “Ornate Guard Sword”, “Ornate Axe” and “One-handed sword”, “Longsword”.
[*] Updated “Longsword” and “Shovel” to include slight movement in primary attacks.
[*] Updated stamina cost of “One Handed Axe”: 20 -> 32.
[*] Updated damage text speed to be more readable.
[*] Updated maze sizes in floors 5, 7, 8 by +1.
[*] Updated spear goblin melee attack damage from 20 -> 10.
[*] Updated “Shovel” to be a heavy weapon (not equippable in off hand slot anymore, different moveset).
[*] Updated Melee Goblins Small Health Potion drop rate: 15% -> 10% | Amount: 2x -> 1x.
[/list]

[b]Bugfixes[/b]

[list]
[*] Improved issues that caused misleading button highlighting/selection in the shop.
[*] There were repeated instances where the inventory seemed to act on its own - selling, equipping, or dropping items that hadn’t actually been selected. We've worked to contain the issue, and it should no longer occur that often. That said, we're keeping a close eye on it and will address any remaining edge cases as soon as they appear.
[*] Fixed spear of goblin sometimes had wrong rotation after getting hit.
[*] Fixed missing translations for options in the settings menu.
[*] Fixed weapons to use the correct slash animation as first animation.
[*] Fixed interactable tooltip was shown after death.
[*] Fixed blocking still activated when opening inventory or pause menu while blocking.
[*] Fixed breakable walls to not influence the camera but rather fade slightly, similar to doors.
[*] Fixed some wrongly set interaction texts
[*] Fixed save & return to menu button not pressable with controller
[*] Fixed seed wasn’t correctly generated for new save games
[*] Fixed an issue causing the player to return to Haven with 0 HP
[*] Fixed some missing localization issues
[*] Fixed an issue where the player couldn’t attack anymore after looting enemies
[/list]

We are already working on the next update, which will feature even more new content, gameplay improvements, and quality-of-life changes. Stay tuned for more…

notes.title: Steam Deck Support!
notes.content:
Great news for all Steam Deck users! While Deepest Dungeons is not officially Steam Deck Verified yet, we’ve tested the game ourselves on the device and it runs great!

[list]
[*] Smooth performance 
[*] Controls work out of the box 
[*] Steam Cloud Save is fully supported – continue your adventure seamlessly between PC and Steam Deck!
[/list]
We’ll of course keep an eye out for any issues and fix them promptly — especially if Steam Verification finally comes knocking in the near future, but in the meantime, feel free to dive into the depths from wherever your Deck takes you.

If you should run into any issues, let us know by joining our [url=https://discord.gg/QUcmAQCqbC]Discord[/url].

tags.feature: Steam Cloud Save is fully supported – continue your adventure seamlessly between PC and Steam Deck!

notes.title: 7 Days Until Launch – Deepest Dungeons is Almost Here!
notes.content:
Hey everyone,
After a lot of work, we’re just 7 days away from launching Deepest Dungeons!
It’s been a long and at times chaotic journey, but we’re finally here - and we’re beyond excited to share this game with you.

As two indie devs working on our very first project, this truly means the world to us. We’ve poured everything we have into crafting this game, and we hope you’ll have just as much fun playing it as we had making it.

If you're just discovering the game, here’s a quick overview of what Deepest Dungeons is all about:

[previewyoutube=1KdnJnfUMOI;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Key Features[/h2]
[list]
[*] Procedurally generated dungeons that grow more dangerous the deeper you go
[*] Risk-and-reward extraction mechanics: escape alive or lose it all
[*] Combat where stamina management and positioning make all the difference
[*] Unique weapons and gear, some with powerful special abilities
[*] Shrines, traps, and secrets scattered throughout the depths
[*] Upgrade your character stats to increase your chances of survival
[*] A gritty atmosphere full of mystery and forgotten history
[*] And much more...
[/list]

Thanks so much for being part of this journey.

In the meantime, be sure to follow us on [url=https://www.threads.net/@unmade_games]Threads[/url], [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@unmade.games]TikTok[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/unmade_games/]Instagram[/url], and join our [url=https://discord.gg/QUcmAQCqbC]Discord[/url] for updates, news, and behind-the-scenes content.

notes.title: The descent will begin soon - Release Date Announcement!
notes.content:
We're planning to release Deepest Dungeons on [b]April 8th, 2025[/b]. We've been working hard since Steam Next Fest to implement the requested feedback, and we're confident you'll love the changes. 

Check out the new trailer to get a little sneak peek of what you can expect!

[previewyoutube=3R5o9XnoMbQ;full][/previewyoutube]


[h2]Improved Features:[/h2]

[list]
[*] Completely reworked maze generation to create more dynamic layouts and introduce new points of interest. 
[*] Added new traps, obstacles, and interactive elements to make the maze more engaging.
[*] Introduced new enemy types, each with unique behaviors and attack patterns. 
[*] Expanded and overhauled the weapon system, adding secondary attacks and special effects to enhance combat. 
[*] Implemented player progression, allowing you to upgrade character stats.
[*] Refined the extraction system to provide more meaningful choices—risk it all for greater rewards or retreat safely. 
[*] Added a quick save system, so you can pause your adventure and return later.
[*] Introduced a New Game Plus mode, challenging brave adventurers with increasing difficulty on each playthrough.
[*] And a ton of other improvements, based on your feedback!
[/list]


We're excited to hear what you think! In the meantime, be sure to follow us on [url=https://www.threads.net/@unmade_games]Threads[/url], [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@unmade.games]TikTok[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/unmade_games/]Instagram[/url], and join our [url=https://discord.gg/QUcmAQCqbC]Discord [/url]for updates, news, and behind-the-scenes content.

notes.title: Patch Notes Version 0.23
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where the gate state to the next level was not saved when returning from Camp Haven.
[*] Fixed a bug where the maze level did not reset after completing the demo.
[*] Fixed a bug where the character layout and inventory were not saved after completing the demo.
[*] Fixed a bug where chalk marks in the maze were not saved when returning from Camp Haven.
[*] Fixed a bug causing armor calculations to work incorrectly.
[*] Fixed a bug where shield armor values were not applied properly.
[*] Fixed a bug where arrow projectiles passed through closed doors.
[*] Fixed a bug where the loading screen icon in the bottom-right corner was not displaying correctly.
[*] Increased the door interaction range.
[*] Decreased enemy drop rates slightly to reduce Health Potion drops.
[*] Decreased torch attack damage from +20 ATK to +8 ATK.
[*] Increased the maximum number of Chalk you can carry from 10 to 20.
[*] Removed misleading item descriptions. (They were a bit ahead of their time - perhaps they’ll return in the future.)
[*] Added temporary visual effects for buffs and debuffs for better clarity. (Don’t worry, we’ll improve them later!)
[*] Consumable items, like Health Potions, now stack when equipped.
[*] Added the ability to quickly loot items with Shift + Left Mouse (Keyboard) / RB + A (Gamepad).
[/list]

Thank you to everyone who provided us with valuable feedback! We’ll keep working hard to improve Deepest Dungeons for all of you.

Stay tuned for updates by following us on social media like [url=https://x.com/Unmade_Games]Twitter [/url]and [url=https://www.threads.net/@unmade_games]Threads[/url], or by joining our [url=https://discord.gg/QUcmAQCqbC]Discord [/url]community!

notes.title: Welcome to Deepest Dungeons – A Roguelike Dungeon Crawler Adventure!
notes.content:
We’re excited to introduce you to our very first game, Deepest Dungeons, a roguelike, top-down dungeon crawler! The demo will be releasing soon as part of the upcoming Steam Next Fest, and we can’t wait for you to try it out.

In Deepest Dungeons, you'll navigate dark, procedurally generated mazes filled with enemies, traps, and powerful items to enhance your character. You'll need to carefully manage both resources and combat, as death means losing all your progress! Survive long enough to reach the exit, and you’ll return to Camp Haven, where you can buy better gear with the items you’ve collected. But if you're feeling brave, you can choose to descend even deeper into the dungeon for greater challenges and rewards.

[previewyoutube=QdGAKm_R9sk;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2][h1]Core Features:[/h1][/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Explore Procedurally Generated Dungeons[/b] – Each dungeon is a unique maze filled with valuable items, treasures, dangerous traps, and lurking enemies.

[*] [b]Find and Equip Items[/b] – Enhance your character’s power by equipping weapons, armor, and other useful gear.

[*] [b]Fight Deadly Enemies[/b] – Battle monsters lurking in the dark corridors. The deeper you go, the tougher the enemies become. Stay alert—every encounter could be your last!

[*] [b]Save Your Equipment[/b] – Discover exits that lead out of the dungeon. Choose wisely: return to the surface to save your progress and store your items in the Stashbox, or venture deeper for even greater rewards at the risk of losing everything.

[*] [b]Trade with NPCs[/b] – Sell items you no longer need and buy better gear to improve your chances of survival.

[*] [b]Descend Even Deeper[/b] – Find Abyss Keys to unlock gates leading to deeper levels, where stronger enemies await, but so do more valuable treasures.
[/list]
We’re really looking forward to hearing your feedback on the demo and later on when the full game releases this year. In the meantime, be sure to follow us on [url=https://x.com/Unmade_Games]Twitter [/url]or [url=https://www.threads.net/@unmade_games]Threads[/url], and join our [url=https://discord.gg/QUcmAQCqbC]Discord [/url]for updates, news, and behind-the-scenes content.
